description: This script manages translation workflows for documentation, including translation generation, path handling, and GitHub PR automation, utilizing external libraries like Typer, GitPython, and OpenAI API.

classes.name: Agent
classes.description: AI agent interface for interacting with OpenAI models, used for generating translations.

classes.name: typer.Typer
classes.description: Main application class for command-line interface commands.

methods.name: get_langs
methods.description: Caches and loads language name mappings from a YAML file.

methods.name: generate_lang_path
methods.description: Generates the path for a translated language file based on the English source path.

methods.name: generate_en_path
methods.description: Generates the English source path from a translated language file path.

methods.name: translate_page
methods.description: Translates a documentation page into a specified language using an AI agent.

methods.name: iter_all_en_paths
methods.description: Iterates over all English markdown documentation files in prioritized order.

methods.name: iter_en_paths_to_translate
methods.description: Filters English documentation files that need translation into a target language.

methods.name: list_llm_translatable
methods.description: Lists languages that can be translated using LLMs based on available prompt files.

methods.name: llm_translatable_json
methods.description: Outputs a JSON list of translatable languages, optionally filtered by a specific language.

methods.name: commands_json
methods.description: Outputs a JSON list of available CLI commands or a specific command if specified.

methods.name: list_removable
methods.description: Lists translated files in a language that can be removed because they lack English source.

methods.name: list_all_removable
methods.description: Lists all removable translated files across all languages.

methods.name: remove_removable
methods.description: Deletes all removable translated files in a specified language.

methods.name: remove_all_removable
methods.description: Deletes all removable translated files across all languages.

methods.name: list_missing
methods.description: Lists documentation files that are missing translations in a target language.

methods.name: list_outdated
methods.description: Lists translated files that are outdated compared to the English source based on commit times.

methods.name: update_outdated
methods.description: Updates a limited number of outdated translations using AI translation.

methods.name: add_missing
methods.description: Adds translations for missing documentation files.

methods.name: update_and_add
methods.description: Performs both updating outdated translations and adding missing ones.

methods.name: make_pr
methods.description: Creates a GitHub pull request with translation updates, handling branch creation and push.
